events.verdict: Jordan (DAL) sets the screen on Bazemore (ATL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Matthews (DAL) briefly has his arms around Len (ATL), but quickly removes them and does not affect Len's SQBR.
Matthews (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Young (ATL).
Jordan (DAL) cleanly blocks Len's (ATL) shot attempt.
Len (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position at the end of Doncic's (DAL) drive.
Bazemore (ATL) legally contests Jordan's (DAL) dunk attempt.
Matthews (DAL) makes marginal contact with Young (ATL) that does not cause him to fall to the floor.
Matthews (DAL) briefly has his arms around Carter (ATL), but removes them and does not affect his SQBR.
Len (ATL) sets the pick on Kleber (DAL) and does not deliver contact.
Bembry (ATL) makes contact with Jordan's (DAL) arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Matthews (DAL) makes contact with Young (ATL) that affects his SQBR.
Bazemore (ATL) briefly places a hand on Matthews' (DAL) hip, but the contact does not affect his FOM as the two players move together.
[Observable in enhanced video] Matthews (DAL) splits his feet at the start of the dribble.
Jordan (DAL) sets the pick on Bazemore (ATL) and does not deliver the contact.
Bazemore (ATL) makes marginal contact with Matthews' (DAL) body after he releases his shot attempt.
Matthews (DAL) makes contact with Young (ATL) and affects his SQBR.
Bazemore (ATL) makes marginal contact with Broekhoff (DAL) during the rebound.
Bazemore (ATL) sets the screen on Brunson (DAL) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Brunson (DAL) commits a take foul on Bazemore (ATL).
Powell (DAL) hooks Carter's (ATL) arm during the pick and the contact affects his ability to defend the play.
Bembry (ATL) jumps from A to B toward Doncic (DAL), but the contact is marginal and does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Broekhoff (DAL) does not intentionally kick the ball.
Broekhoff (DAL) establishes a legal guarding position in Young's (ATL) path.
Finney-Smith (DAL) and Young (ATL) briefly engage and separate.
Finney-Smith (DAL) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
